headline: Share gear across characters and zoom your way
intro: Your wardrobe now reaches across every character, and the stage zooms the way you expect. Export to RPG Maker, and enjoy tidier lists and menus along the way.

highlights.title: Wear items from other characters
highlights.text: Items from other characters now appear on every character, including the demo. Items made for a different body can be worn as drawn and are marked Needs a look.

highlights.title: Export walking sheets for RPG Maker
highlights.text: A new RPG Maker card exports a walking sheet per outfit. Its Version menu lets you choose Standard (MZ, MV, VX Ace, VX) or XP (XP and Pokemon Essentials).

highlights.title: Zoom the scene to true size
highlights.text: 100% now shows your character at true size. Wheel, keys and buttons step through the same zoom levels on both screens, and a wheel or pinch zooms the Characters scene.

highlights.title: Two-handed items and separate hands
highlights.text: Main hand and Off hand are now separate wardrobe groups, so a sword and a shield are made and worn separately. A Two-handed switch makes an item hide the other hand.

fixes.text: Startup now shows a Reload button instead of getting stuck on the opening message.
Newly opened wardrobes now start at the top of the list.
Wheel input over a scrollable list scrolls it instead of switching characters.
